title: Emoji Extravaganza
theme: Emoji puzzles about Disney films, songs and parks
intro: [excited] Phones out, emojis up! Tonight is Emoji Extravaganza: Disney movies, songs and park favorites told in tiny pictures. [laughs] If you've ever texted a winky face, you're already qualified.

art.prompt: Giant colorful glossy speech bubbles and round smiley-style faces floating over a fairy-tale park at sunset, with hearts, stars and sparkles bursting like fireworks Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Emoji IRL
categories.intro: Our Parks category is real photos, plus an emoji hint! [chuckles] Name the park spot in the picture.

art.prompt: A giant smartphone lying on a picnic blanket in a theme park, its screen glowing with bubbles of mountains, towers and boats, real rides blurred behind Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: 🏔️🛷 This snowy mountain coaster opened at Disneyland in 1959. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Matterhorn Bobsleds! It was the first tubular steel roller coaster. [laughs] Watch out for Harold the Abominable Snowman!

clues.clue: 🥐🗼🎨 This EPCOT World Showcase pavilion has its own mini Eiffel Tower. Name the country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is France! [chuckles] The Eiffel Tower there is built with forced perspective. And the pastries? Ooh la la!

clues.clue: 🏯🎎🍣 This EPCOT pavilion is home to a five-story pagoda. Name the country.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Japan! The pagoda is inspired by one at Horyuji temple in Nara. [laughs] And the Mitsukoshi store is a souvenir paradise.

clues.clue: 🎡🎢🍬 This Disney California Adventure area, with its giant wheel and loop coaster, opened in 2018. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pixar Pier! [laughs] It replaced Paradise Pier, and the coaster became the Incredicoaster. Hold on to your baby Jack-Jack!

clues.clue: 🛶🌲🙋 Guests paddle these themselves on Disneyland's Rivers of America. Name the attraction.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Davy Crockett's Explorer Canoes! The only Disneyland attraction where you're the engine. [laughs] Paddle, people, paddle!

categories.title: Emoji Remix
categories.intro: I'll text you a movie in emojis. [chuckles] You text me back the title. Well, buzz in. Same thing.

art.prompt: A row of shiny glossy 3D bubble icons on a pastel background: a race car, a bunny, a butterfly, a robot and a crystal Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: 🏎️⚡🏆 A rookie race car learns there's more to life than winning.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cars! Ka-chow! [laughs] Radiator Springs is waiting at Disney California Adventure.

clues.clue: 🐰👮🦊 A bunny cop and a sly fox crack a case in a city of animals.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Zootopia! [chuckles] Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde. And don't forget Flash, the fastest sloth at the DMV.

clues.clue: 🏠🦋🕯️ A magical house in Colombia and the one family member without a gift.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Encanto! Mirabel, Casita and that magic candle. [whispers] We don't talk about Bruno.

clues.clue: 🤖🎈🩹 An inflatable health-care robot and a teen genius team up in San Fransokyo.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Big Hero 6! [laughs] Baymax is your personal healthcare companion. Fist bump: ba-la-la-la-la!

clues.clue: 🌊🏙️💎📖 A linguist uses a journal to find a lost sunken civilization.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Atlantis: The Lost Empire! Milo Thatch reads the Shepherd's Journal, and Mike Mignola helped design the look. [chuckles] Nerd points!

categories.title: Emoji Sing-Along
categories.intro: Name that tune, emoji style! [laughs] Bonus points if you sing it. Not really. But do it anyway.

art.prompt: Floating musical notes and glossy 3D bubble icons of a microphone, a crab, a monkey and a heart bouncing over a stage spotlight Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: 🙅🗣️👨‍🦱 Everyone in the Madrigal family has a reason not to talk about him.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is We Don't Talk About Bruno! It hit number one on the Billboard Hot 100. [laughs] So now we do talk about Bruno. A lot.

clues.clue: 🌊🦀🎶 A crab promises life is better down where it's wetter.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Under the Sea! [chuckles] Sebastian's big number won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

clues.clue: 🐗🚫😟 A warthog and a meerkat's problem-free philosophy.
choices: I Just Can't Wait to Be King
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Hakuna Matata! It means no worries for the rest of your days. [chuckles] Pumbaa's flatulence is part of the lyrics.

clues.clue: 👉🤝😊 Randy Newman's opening song from the first Toy Story.
clues.answer: You've Got a Friend in Me
accept: you got a friend in me
you've got a friend in me
youve got a friend in me
choices: You've Got a Friend in Me
I Will Go Sailing No More
clues.reveal: The correct answer is You've Got a Friend in Me! [excited] Randy Newman sings it himself. Woody approved.

clues.clue: 🐒👑🔥 A swinging jungle king wants to learn the secret of man's red fire.
accept: i wan'na be like you (the monkey song)
i want to be like you
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is I Wan'na Be Like You! Louis Prima voiced King Louie. [laughs] The Sherman Brothers wrote it.

categories.title: Emoji Park Day
categories.intro: A whole day at the parks, told in emojis! [chuckles] Name the attraction.

art.prompt: A cheerful park map spread on a table with glossy 3D bubble icons scattered across it: a boat, a hang glider, a car, a giraffe and a parrot Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: 🐘🚤🌴 Skippers tell terrible puns on this river boat tour.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is the Jungle Cruise! [chuckles] The backside of water. The skippers never get tired of that one, and neither do I.

clues.clue: 🪂🌍🍊 Hang-glide over famous landmarks while smelling oranges and the sea at EPCOT.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Soarin'! [excited] The smells are pumped into the theater. [laughs] Your nose gets a ride too.

clues.clue: 🚗🔧💨 Design your own car and test it at up to 65 miles per hour at EPCOT.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Test Track! [laughs] It's one of the fastest Disney rides in Florida. Hold on to your fender.

clues.clue: 🦒🚙🌍 A bumpy open-vehicle ride through African savanna at Animal Kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kilimanjaro Safaris! [chuckles] Real giraffes, real elephants, and a driver who knows every bump in the road.

clues.clue: 🦜🇲🇽🚤 A boat ride in EPCOT's Mexico pavilion starring Donald and his two caballero pals.
accept: gran fiesta tour starring the three caballeros
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Gran Fiesta Tour starring the Three Caballeros! It replaced El Río del Tiempo in 2007. [laughs] Donald gets lost, again.

categories.title: Symbols and Signs
categories.intro: Emojis are just tiny symbols, and Disney is full of famous ones. [whispers] Our fan category is all about Disney's real-life symbols.

art.prompt: A park plaza at dawn with an empty bronze statue pedestal, a giant wizard-style hat shape made of hedges and three overlapping circles hidden in a mosaic floor Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Three overlapping circles hidden in a ride or building are called a Hidden this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a Hidden Mickey! [laughs] Once you start spotting them, you can't stop. Every plate, every gear, every bubble.

clues.clue: The Partners statue near the castle shows Walt Disney holding hands with this character.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey Mouse! [sighs] Walt and Mickey looking down Main Street. Gets me every time.

clues.clue: Walt said, 'I only hope that we never lose sight of one thing, that it was all started by' this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a mouse! [chuckles] Walt said that in 1954, the year before Disneyland opened.

clues.clue: From 2001 to 2015, a giant version of this famous blue starry hat stood at the center of Disney's Hollywood Studios.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Sorcerer's Hat! [laughs] Now the Chinese Theatre has its view back. Some fans miss the hat, though.

clues.clue: This Imagineer sculpted the Partners statue of Walt and Mickey, unveiled at Disneyland in 1993.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Blaine Gibson! He also sculpted many of the presidents in the Hall of Presidents. [chuckles] True nerd points!
